headline: Singapore Expresses Disappointment Over Proposed US Tariffs
summary: Singapore voiced strong disappointment regarding the Trump administration's proposed new import tariffs on 14 trading partners, which threaten to raise consumer electronics prices and impact international trade.
why: As a major global trade and logistics hub, Singapore's economy is highly sensitive to shifts in US trade policy and protectionist measures.

impacts.name: Singapore
impacts.why: Proposed US tariffs directly affect Singapore's export-oriented manufacturing and trade economy.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
